## 2. Interval calibration -- PRIMARY evidence

Pooled post-cutoff walk-forward coverage, leave-one-out. Scoring an interval against the very residuals that defined its quantiles would be circular, so each observation is held out and the quantiles rebuilt from the rest.

| target | horizon | champion | evidence | n | n_covered | empirical_coverage | nominal_coverage | band_low | band_high | covers_nominal | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Children in HHS Care | 1 | naive | primary_pooled_folds_leave_one_out | 15 | 13 | 0.8667 | 0.95 | 0.6212 | 0.9626 | True | N is small (15); the band is wide and this is not a precise calibration estimate |
| Children in HHS Care | 7 | naive | primary_pooled_folds_leave_one_out | 14 | 10 | 0.7143 | 0.95 | 0.4535 | 0.8828 | False | N is small (14); the band is wide and this is not a precise calibration estimate |
| Children in HHS Care | 14 | naive | primary_pooled_folds_leave_one_out | 14 | 12 | 0.8571 | 0.95 | 0.6006 | 0.9599 | True | N is small (14); the band is wide and this is not a precise calibration estimate |
| Children discharged from HHS Care | 1 | naive | primary_pooled_folds_leave_one_out | 15 | 12 | 0.8 | 0.95 | 0.5481 | 0.9295 | False | N is small (15); the band is wide and this is not a precise calibration estimate |
| Children discharged from HHS Care | 7 | naive | primary_pooled_folds_leave_one_out | 14 | 12 | 0.8571 | 0.95 | 0.6006 | 0.9599 | True | N is small (14); the band is wide and this is not a precise calibration estimate |
| Children discharged from HHS Care | 14 | seasonal_naive | primary_pooled_folds_leave_one_out | 12 | 10 | 0.8333 | 0.95 | 0.552 | 0.953 | True | N is small (12); the band is wide and this is not a precise calibration estimate |

`covers_nominal` asks whether the nominal 95% falls inside the binomial band sized to the achieved N. **2 of 6 cells fall outside it.** Every gap disclosed below and carried into Limitations -- never closed by widening the interval after the fact.

These N are 12-15, exactly as the addendum anticipated ("low tens, not hundreds"). The bands are correspondingly wide and these are not precise calibration estimates.

## 4. Derived imbalance signal

Transferred Out minus Discharged, with Transferred Out on the baseline treatment required for every series -- never a third target.

| horizon | transferred_forecast | discharged_forecast | net_pressure | std | uncertainty_form | measured_correlation | interpretation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 9.0 | 14.0 | -5.0 | 7.98 | independence | -0.15317141932697156 | exits exceed intake -- net relief |
| 7 | 15.0 | 14.0 | 1.0 | 14.31 | independence | 0.15287106069334166 | intake exceeds exits -- net inflow pressure |
| 14 | 6.0 | 16.0 | -10.0 | 9.02 | independence | 0.1600607127398115 | exits exceed intake -- net relief |

Uncertainty form: **independence**. The full `Var(A-B) = Var(A) + Var(B) - 2*Cov(A,B)` is the default; the independence simplification applies only where the MEASURED paired residual correlation earns it (|r| < 0.20, established at Day 8).

## 5. Early-warning KPIs -- development portion only

The trigger is replayed at every development-portion origin under the frozen 90th-percentile rule. Nothing is tuned: the percentile is a stated convention, so this measures what the fixed rule would have done.

| target | origins | fired | true_pos | false_pos | false_neg | true_neg | median_lead_time | FP_rate | FN_rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Children in HHS Care | 65 | 13 | 13 | 0 | 6 | 46 | 1.0 | 0.0 | 0.115 |
| Children discharged from HHS C | 65 | 2 | 2 | 0 | 30 | 33 | 2.5 | 0.0 | 0.476 |

Lead time is measured in **period-positions, not calendar days** -- consistent with every other offset in this project. False-positive and false-negative rates are reported alongside it as the addendum requires, "a required metric, not optional".

## 6. KPI summary

| target | capacity_tier | threshold_proxy_value | median_surge_lead_time_periods | false_positive_rate | false_negative_rate | forecast_stability_index |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Children in HHS Care | High | 2450.6 | 1.0 | 0.0 | 0.11538461538461539 | 2.05 |
| Children discharged from HHS Care | Normal | 16.0 | 2.5 | 0.0 | 0.47619047619047616 | 1.34 |

**Every capacity figure above is a relative, data-derived proxy.** Relative, data-derived proxy for unusually high load by this programme's own recent standards. No official capacity threshold exists in the source documentation or the dataset; this is not an official capacity figure and does not indicate that capacity has been or will be breached.

**Forecast Stability Index is a disclosed substitution.** The roadmap's definition -- variance of forecasts for the same target date from different origins -- is not computable under the frozen fold cadence: origins are 10 period-positions apart and horizon gaps are 6/7/13, so no test position is ever reached from two origins (0 of 195, measured). Substituted with the p90/median absolute-error ratio across holdout origins.
